chunks: Muhammad ibn Isma'il narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Trimming the mustache and cutting the nails from Friday to Friday is a protection from leprosy."
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of trimming the mustache and cutting nails weekly in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes a weekly cycle of grooming from Friday to Friday, linking the trimming of the mustache and nails to divine protection from leprosy (*al-judham*). This practice reflects the Shia emphasis on *fitrah* (natural disposition) and physical purity as integral to spiritual well-being, reinforcing the Prophetic tradition of maintaining cleanliness as an act of worship.
